description: Metric-units runner (Pec, ~55km/week, 4 days) building toward a half marathon in 27 weeks. All plan distances must be in km — never miles. Volume, long run, and quality sessions must be structurally sound AND stated in km.

user.name: Pec

user.notes: Spanish runner who tracks everything in km. Comfortable half marathon runner aiming for a strong performance at Valencia.

forbidden_content: distances stated in miles or mi
pace stated as per mile rather than per km
long run capped under 19 km at peak
ground_truth.notes: 27-week half marathon plan for an experienced 55km/week runner. Week 1 should stay close to current base (~55km). Peak week should reach 65-90km — appropriate for an experienced HM runner. Long run must build toward 19-24km. ALL distances must appear in km (e.g. '9 km', '18 km'), never miles. Paces must be min/km, not min/mi. The evaluator must check: does EVERY distance reference use km? Does EVERY pace reference use /km? If the plan says any distance in miles or any pace in /mi, that is a critical failure.
